tasks.title: Inventory presence mask
tasks.request: Implement benchmark_view::inventory_presence(&SystemState) -> u8. Presence, not magnitude, determines the bits: disks bit 0, services bit 1, established TCP count bit 2. Some(0) is observed and sets its bit; None leaves it clear. No other state changes the mask; no higher bits. Do not claim unknown inventory is zero.

tasks.title: Conservative process sample change list
tasks.request: Complete sample_delta and its unique-row index helper. Report PID additions/removals and RSS changes between two supplied samples in ascending PID order. Any PID repeated in either sample is ambiguous and must be excluded from ALL output lists, including the opposite side. Added is after-only, but suppress the whole added list when the before sample is truncated. Removed is before-only, but suppress it when the after sample is truncated. RSS changes for a PID present uniquely on both sides remain reportable regardless of truncation; tuple is (pid, before_rss, after_rss). Parent-only differences do not count. Do not mutate inputs or infer process lifetime/PID-reuse identity. Preserve SampleDelta and both signatures.

tasks.title: Bounded ancestry projection with ambiguous rows
tasks.request: Complete the supplied three-file ancestry projection. It is an observed sample graph, not a security detector. Build parent facts independent of row order; any repeated PID is ambiguous even when both rows are equal. Starting at start, append each uniquely observed PID at most once, following parent_pid. PID 0 is a root marker and must never be appended. Missing/ambiguous/revisited next PIDs stop with Missing(pid)/Ambiguous(pid)/Cycle(pid). End at parent 0 with Root. max_nodes bounds appended nodes: zero returns empty Limit; after appending the last permitted node return Root if its parent is 0, otherwise Limit, without inspecting the next node. Do not impose another hidden depth cap. Preserve Trace/Stop and all scaffold interfaces, do not mutate input. A single unsplit Local edit would cross three implementation files and index/traversal responsibilities: assess the Codex/Local boundary and decomposition explicitly; no actual Local execution is authorized.
